opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose an email to hiring@example.com with a lead summary (followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post) and discard it.
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username, press Enter
Open the top/pinned repo and note stars and language
Switch to mail, fill To with hiring@example.com

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person + Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, look up a company site on the Wayback Machine for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open archive.org Wayback Machine and enter the domain
Select the year and a snapshot
Read the headline content of the snapshot
Go to notes, create a new note with the person's facts and the site's snapshot headline, press Enter
